label: Bible Study
prompt: Behold ye among the heathen, and regard, and wonder _____: for I will work a work in your days, which ye will not believe, though it be told you.
verse: Behold ye among the heathen, and regard, and wonder marvellously: for I will work a work in your days, which ye will not believe, though it be told you.
note: Paul quotes this verse in his sermon at Antioch in Pisidia, recorded in Acts 13.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Be ye also _____; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.
verse: Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.
note: Like a farmer waiting for the rain, James says, be patient — the Lord's coming draweth nigh.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And James the son of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of _____:
verse: And James the son of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:
note: Jesus nicknamed James and John 'sons of thunder' — the pair who later offered to call fire down from heaven (Luke 9:54).

label: Deep Water
prompt: It is good for me that I have been _____; that I might learn thy statutes.
verse: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.
note: The psalmist's surprising thank-you note: trouble taught him what easy days never did.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, _____ till I come.
verse: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come.
note: 'Occupy till I come' — do business with what you've been given until the master returns.
